advice_items.quote: Working really, really hard.
advice_items.summary_en: Work extremely hard to build wealth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 通过极度努力工作积累财富

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Invest Within Your Circle of Competence
advice_items.quote: Invest in things you understand.
advice_items.summary_en: Only invest in assets and businesses you genuinely understand.
advice_items.summary_zh: 只投资自己真正理解的领域

advice_items.quote: Residential. ... Anywhere where there's coastal properties. ... red states obviously are better because of the tax breaks.
advice_items.summary_en: Buy residential real estate in strong coastal markets and tax-advantaged states.
advice_items.summary_zh: 配置沿海及税务优惠州的住宅房产

advice_items.quote: I believe in doing things fairly and that business can be a win-win for anybody ... Everybody deserves a break and a chance to prove themselves in business.
advice_items.summary_en: Conduct business fairly, aim for win-win outcomes, and give people a chance.
advice_items.summary_zh: 坚持公平共赢，给他人证明自己的机会

advice_items.quote: employees, you have to hire people that you trust.
advice_items.summary_en: Hire trustworthy, capable employees when running companies.
advice_items.summary_zh: 创业必须雇佣值得信赖的人才

advice_items.quote: An LLC is a veil of protection and everybody should understand their taxes. It will serve you for the rest of your life.
advice_items.summary_en: Use LLCs to protect assets and learn tax fundamentals early.
advice_items.summary_zh: 善用LLC隔离风险并终生精通税务知识

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Enjoy Life While You Are Alive
advice_items.quote: Live while you're alive. ... Enjoy your life.
advice_items.summary_en: Remember to enjoy your life while building and holding wealth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 趁活着好好享受人生，别只顾赚钱

guests.first_money_or_break: 在金融行业工作并拥有企业，自1990年代起在洛杉矶沿海及税务优惠州投资住宅房地产，名下持有超过50家LLC公司。
guests.guest_name: Beverly Hills Finance & Real Estate Investor
guests.role_or_title: Finance Executive & Real Estate Investor (50+ LLCs)
guests.wealth_detail: $1B business figure stated; owns 50+ real estate LLCs
guests.zero_start_advice: 极度努力工作，只投资自己理解的资产（如住宅房产），通过LLC保护资产并深入理解税务，同时别忘了享受生活。

advice_items.quote: Everybody, my own husband didn't believe that this will be a business. ... Cuz I really believed it.
advice_items.summary_en: Believe in your vision even when banks, landlords, and family doubt you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 无视周围人甚至家人的质疑，坚定相信自己

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.quote: I really believe that eyebrow is such an important feature in our face and I fixed my own eyebrow. This is how everything started.
advice_items.summary_en: Build a business by solving a real personal pain point first.
advice_items.summary_zh: 从解决自身真实痛点出发创造产品价值

advice_items.quote: If you want to start your own business, watch the cash flow. EBITDA is everything. You know, it's all about the profit.
advice_items.summary_en: Watch cash flow, EBITDA, and profitability closely when starting out.
advice_items.summary_zh: 紧盯现金流与EBITDA，利润才是根本

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.quote: Don't start spending money left and right. When I started, I was driving a beat up car that I spent $200. ... I had a bigger goals and it was important for me to save every penny to put into my business.
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid status spending and drive a cheap car to save every penny early on.
advice_items.summary_zh: 初期拒绝虚荣消费，开200美元破车省钱创业

advice_items.quote: Every money I will generate I will put back into the business.
advice_items.summary_en: Reinvest all generated profits back into growing the business.
advice_items.summary_zh: 将赚到的每一分钱全部复投进业务扩张

advice_items.quote: You make a lot of mistakes. I made many mistakes, but you learn from your mistakes. And the key is to never make the same mistake twice.
advice_items.summary_en: Learn from inevitable mistakes and never repeat the same mistake twice.
advice_items.summary_zh: 从大量错误中吸取教训，绝不犯同样的错两次

advice_items.quote: we're the first beauty brand having a presence on Instagram and this is how we scale. It exploded the company.
advice_items.summary_en: Adopt social media and creator seeding early to scale distribution rapidly.
advice_items.summary_zh: 抢占Instagram先机并联动博主，引爆品牌增长

advice_items.quote: You have to adapt. You have to pivot. Business changes every day. Right now with AI, I want to learn more. I want to implement AI as much as I can
advice_items.summary_en: Constantly adapt to change and adopt new tools like AI across operations.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持警觉随时转型，积极学习并全面应用AI

advice_items.quote: I work like I can't pay my rent next month. ... I love what I do. I don't even feel like I work.
advice_items.summary_en: Work with hunger while loving the craft and daily problem-solving.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持危机感的同时热爱事业，把工作当乐趣

advice_items.quote: Don't be afraid to start to do whatever your heart is telling you.
advice_items.summary_en: Do not be afraid to start pursuing what your heart pulls you toward.
advice_items.summary_zh: 不要害怕，勇敢迈出第一步去做内心想做的事

advice_items.quote: I used to go to the library. I used to read to do my homework and be passionate about whatever I was doing.
advice_items.summary_en: Build a foundation by reading, studying diligently, and staying passionate.
advice_items.summary_zh: 去图书馆大量阅读学习，在热爱的领域深耕

guests.first_money_or_break: 从罗马尼亚移民美国时身无分文且不懂英语，1997年从解决自身修眉痛点起步创立Anastasia Beverly Hills，2018年以30亿美元估值出售且此前100%持股。
guests.wealth_detail: Company valued at $3B when sold in 2018 (100% ownership prior)
guests.zero_start_advice: 不要害怕开始并坚持自信，初期绝不乱花钱虚荣攀比，盯紧现金流与利润并把赚到的钱不断复投，同时拥抱社媒与AI等新变化。

advice_items.canonical_tag: Work Under a Winner First Before Starting
advice_items.quote: My job was to keep rich people rich for a living. I came up with the idea in 2013, but we didn't make our money until 2017 as a business.
advice_items.summary_en: Learn wealth mechanics working with billionaires on Wall Street before launching.
advice_items.summary_zh: 先在华尔街近距离服务顶级富豪，再辞职创业

advice_items.quote: 80% of their money typically is in marketable securities. ... 10% in cash and 10% in alternative investments ... Wealthy people do not put their money in cash. It's always in something that has a potential to grow their wealth.
advice_items.summary_en: Keep most wealth invested in marketable securities and alternatives rather than cash.
advice_items.summary_zh: 效仿富豪80%配置证券10%另类投资，不囤现金

advice_items.quote: Wealthy people put their money to work. ... they give their money a job description. You cannot save or work your way to wealth. You can only invest your way there.
advice_items.summary_en: Give your money a job description because you cannot save or work to wealth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 不能靠死存钱或打工致富，必须让钱为你工作

advice_items.quote: one of the biggest things I learned about a 1% on Wall Street, they believe they have power. They believe they deserve to be in a room. ... I knew that I could be a billionaire because I was in that room.
advice_items.summary_en: Adopt the mindset that you belong in the room and deserve wealth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 打破身份设限，坚信自己配得上坐在顶级牌桌上

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.quote: the key is ownership. You have to create your wealth by owning companies that you know you use and believe in or create your own business.
advice_items.summary_en: Build wealth through equity ownership in companies or your own business.
advice_items.summary_zh: 致富核心在于股权所有权，买优质公司或自创企业

guests.first_money_or_break: 出身中产家庭，成为家族首位大学生与百万富翁；曾在华尔街为富人管理资产，2013年离职创办科技公司，2017年实现盈利并在33岁成为百万富翁，单年最高收入接近1000万美元。
guests.guest_name: Atlanta Tech Founder & Former Wall Street Banker
guests.role_or_title: Tech Company CEO & Former Wall Street Professional
guests.wealth_detail: Just shy of $10M in a single year
guests.zero_start_advice: 财富始于内心信念，先相信自己配得上进入顶级圈层；不要只靠省钱和打工，要通过拥有公司股权或自己创业并积极投资让钱生钱。

advice_items.quote: I had $5,000 that I had saved myself from selling fax machines door-to-door for seven years. ... Do you want to spend your five grand on a vacation or do you want to try to bet on yourself?
advice_items.summary_en: Bet your hard-earned savings on yourself instead of playing it safe.
advice_items.summary_zh: 用攒下的5000美元赌自己一把，敢于承担风险

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.quote: I never had a single investor in Spanx other than me. ... Self-funded the entire 21 years. ... whatever you give away in your business, you have to be very willing to give up.
advice_items.summary_en: Retain ownership and control by self-funding instead of giving away equity.
advice_items.summary_zh: 坚持21年零外部融资，牢牢守住股权与控制权

advice_items.quote: I always pay attention to intuition over data, and I don't think investors really understand that. ... intuition's not on a spreadsheet.
advice_items.summary_en: Honor entrepreneurial intuition over spreadsheets when making key bets.
advice_items.summary_zh: 重视直觉高于冷冰冰的表格数据，保持独立判断

advice_items.quote: Rejection is my middle name. ... by the time I started Spanx, rejection I knew was just part of the formula to success. ... Oh, I'm closer to my yes.
advice_items.summary_en: Reframe every rejection as proof that you are getting closer to a yes.
advice_items.summary_zh: 把拒绝视为成功公式的一部分，越被拒离肯定越近

advice_items.quote: I took bins that I bought at Office Depot and stuck them at every cash register in the store ... You do whatever it takes. And I always say ask for forgiveness, not permission.
advice_items.summary_en: Take bold guerrilla action to get products in front of buyers; ask forgiveness, not permission.
advice_items.summary_zh: 不择手段推进业务，先斩后奏把产品摆到收银台

advice_items.quote: I waited a year before I told any friends or family what I was working on. ... ideas are the most vulnerable in the moment you have them.
advice_items.summary_en: Keep new ideas quiet for a year so early doubts do not kill them.
advice_items.summary_zh: 想法最脆弱的头一年先对亲友保密，避免被泼冷水

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.quote: the way that I saw that it solved my problem with my clothes. ... I filled a void that women had been waiting for me to fill.
advice_items.summary_en: Create products that fill an unmet functional void for customers.
advice_items.summary_zh: 敏锐发现并填补长期未被满足的消费者刚需空白

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Innovate in Declining or Overlooked Industries
advice_items.quote: I went into an industry that was in a double-digit decline. ... I'm interested in like what industries are sort of dying on the vine and why?
advice_items.summary_en: Look for declining industries where legacy players stopped solving problems.
advice_items.summary_zh: 逆向切入衰退或被忽视的行业，用创新重塑品类

guests.first_money_or_break: 挨家挨户推销传真机7年攒下5000美元作为全部启动资金，21年零外部融资创办并100%持有Spanx，在Neiman Marcus将产品主动摆上收银台后迅速爆红，最终以12亿美元出售公司。
guests.wealth_detail: Sold Spanx for $1.2B; made hundreds of millions in a single year
guests.zero_start_advice: 解决一个真实痛点，赌上自己并保持乐趣；在想法刚萌芽最脆弱的头一年先悄悄打磨，不要急于听亲友意见，同时把无数次拒绝当成通往成功的必经之路。
